meta.notes: A world clock is a counter of ticks with no settings of its own, which is why its data is empty. The game keeps one value per clock and advances it every tick; vanilla has minecraft:overworld and minecraft:the_end. A timeline follows a clock through its clock field, and a dimension type names its default_clock, the one /time changes. A timeline with "clock": "msm_examples:tide_clock" runs on its own time, untouched by /time set or sleeping.
